prompt: Who was the most recent Sheriff of Los Angeles County killed in the line of duty?
answer:
The most recent **Los Angeles County sheriff to be killed in the line of duty was Sheriff William C. Getman**, who died in **1857**.  

(If referring more broadly to LASD personnel, Detectives **Victor Lemus, Joshua Kelley-Eklund, and William Osborn** were killed in the July 18, 2025 Biscailuz Training Center explosion.)
